description.value: River Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on West Broadway serving a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, nigiri, and tempura in both dine-in and takeout formats. The restaurant emphasizes fresh ingredients and authentic Japanese cuisine, and has built a local following in the Vancouver community. Touring cyclists heading along the Broadway corridor will find a wide variety of options including vegetarian-friendly rolls and bento-style rice bowls.
